_readme: 創世決戦OP曲を ElevenLabs Music（music_v1）で作り直すときの構成プラン。sections の duration_ms は index.html の GENESIS_STORY_SCENE_DURATIONS_MS（8場面の表示時間）と一致させてあり、各セクションの頭が場面の切り替えになる。120BPM・4/4 で1小節2秒なので、どの場面も小節の頭で切り替わる。生成後は曲を解析し、実際の拍のずれを GENESIS_STORY_BEAT_OFFSET_SEC に反映すること。 prompt と music_length_ms は、構成プランを使わず文章だけで作る場合（--prompt）用。
prompt: Instrumental dark Japanese fantasy cinematic score for a 90-second story prologue, 120 BPM in steady 4/4. Traditional Japanese instruments (taiko, shamisen, shakuhachi, koto, shinobue) blended with dark orchestral strings, low brass and an epic wordless choir. Structure with clear section changes on strong downbeats: 0-12s quiet mysterious koto and shakuhachi over a soft drone; 12-20s a sudden massive taiko and low brass impact as dragons awaken, rising tension; 20-36s full dark orchestra with pounding taiko, destruction and chaos; 36-52s heroic epic battle with fast shamisen, choir and brass fanfare; 52-60s sudden drop to near silence, lonely solo shakuhachi, desolate; 60-68s shimmering bells and gentle koto, hope and wonder; 68-76s tense dissonant strings and pulsing low taiko building conflict; 76-90s grand finale with full choir, taiko and orchestra, ending on one huge unison hit with a short ringing tail. No vocals with lyrics, no pop or electronic elements, no tempo changes.

positive_global_styles: traditional Japanese instruments: taiko drums, shamisen, shakuhachi, koto, shinobue
blended with dark orchestral strings, low brass and epic choir
ink-wash painting atmosphere, mythic and solemn
every section begins exactly on a strong downbeat accent

sudden massive taiko and low brass impact on the first beat
